summary: Styles for the About section of the application, including timeline, timeline items, content, and animations.
evidence: .timeline::before { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 4px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #5a2ca0, #ff6bb3); }
.timelineItem { padding: 10px 40px; position: relative; width: 50%; box-sizing: border-box; }
.timelineItem::after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 20px; height: 20px; right: -10px; background-color: #ffffff; border: 4px solid #5a2ca0; }
.timelineContent { padding: 20px 30px; background-color: white; position: relative; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(90, 44, 160, 0.1); border-top: 3px solid #ff6bb3; }
.footerContent { display: flex; max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 2rem; }
